item.text: The shared utility is `subscriptionExpires` in the payments helpers. I also found cancellation config code that directly chooses the upcoming term’s end date, so I’m checking both paths and their existing tests before changing them.

item.text: The utility now accepts an optional cancellation context, and the cancellation confirmation date components source their date from it. I’m tightening the auto-renew condition to cover disabled renewal on either the active subscription or its scheduled term, then I’ll run the targeted test suite.

item.text:
Implemented cancellation-aware expiry calculation. Cancellation confirmations in both B2C and B2B now get the end date from `subscriptionExpires`, which reports the active term’s date and plan when cancellation is in progress or auto-renew is disabled. Free plan behavior is unchanged.

The targeted test suite passed: 31 tests. `git diff --check` also passed.
